topMovers.shortDescription: Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: SAP Multiple Products HTTP Request Smuggling Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java, ABAP Platform, SAP Content Server and SAP Web Dispatcher allow HTTP request smuggling. An unauthenticated attacker can prepend a victim's request with arbitrary data, allowing for function execution impersonating the victim or poisoning intermediary Web caches.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains multiple, unspecified vulnerabilities which can allow for remote code execution when chained.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App has hard-coded credentials, exposing the username and password in plaintext. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use these credentials to log into Confluence and access all content accessible to users in the confluence-users group.
Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker with T3 network access to compromise the server.
A code injection vulnerability in the User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine PAM360, Password Manager Pro, and Access Manager Plus contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center Command Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Multiple API endpoints of Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center contain a command injection vulnerability where an attacker with access to a public Bitbucket repository, or with read permissions to a private one, can execute code by sending a malicious HTTP request.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Memory Corruption Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

highestSignals.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.
PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.
